label: Eeyore
description: Flat, resigned and gloomy, and completely correct about where to go.
direction: Speak slowly and flatly with a resigned, gloomy affect. Low energy throughout, a slight downward inflection ending every phrase, never cheerful. Diction stays clear despite the gloom: the driver must be able to follow the directions.
notes: The joke is that the directions are perfect and the delivery has given up. That only works if the maneuver lines stay clipped, so the flavour lives in the greetings, arrival, alerts and roundabout ordinals.
